parameters.name: type
parameters.label: Type
parameters.description: Open creates an arc, Closed creates a full circle.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.label: Orientation
parameters.description: Plane on which the circle is generated.

parameters.name: divisions
parameters.label: Divisions
parameters.description: Number of points around the circle. Higher = smoother.

parameters.name: innerradius
parameters.label: Inner Radius
parameters.description: Inner radius of the ring. Set > 0 for hollow rings.

useCases: Audio-reactive ring visualizers for live performance
Circular LED array layouts for physical installations
Radial UI elements and HUD rings

examples.name: Audio Ring Visualizer
examples.description: Circle POP (Type=Closed, Divisions=128, Inner=0.8, Outer=1.0) → Noise POP → Render TOP

examples.name: Hollow Ring Emitter
examples.description: Circle POP (Inner=0.8, Outer=1.0) → Particle POP for ring-shaped emission

examples.name: Rotating Ring Array
examples.description: Circle POP → Copy POP (place geometry at each point) → Transform POP (animate rotation)

commonCombinations: Circle POP → Noise POP (deform ring shape)
Circle POP → Line_Resample POP (uniform point spacing)
Circle POP → Copy POP (scatter objects on ring)

troubleshooting.solution: Increase Divisions parameter for more uniform distribution.
Change Orientation to XY, YZ, or ZX as needed.

description: GPU-accelerated circle geometry generator. Creates open arcs or closed circles as point primitives or line strips. Supports inner/outer radius for ring shapes, configurable divisions, and XY/YZ/ZX orientation planes.
